note: Public declarations that scripts/check_print_axioms.py does not collect, each with the reason it cannot. These are NOT unchecked: check_audit_coverage.py computes their axioms from the elaborated environment via Lean.collectAxioms, independently of the source-text patterns. This file records only that the regex audit does not reach them, so the gap is written down rather than silent. A hand-written declaration does not belong here -- if one appears, fix the pattern in check_print_axioms.py instead.

categories.ext-attribute: The `@[ext]` attribute generates `ext_iff` from a structure or from a hand-written `ext` theorem, and generates `ext` itself when applied to a structure. The generated companion carries a source range pointing at the syntax it was derived from, so it is indistinguishable from hand-written code by range alone; it has no source name for a text pattern to capture.
categories.derived-instance-helper: A helper nested inside an instance that a `deriving` clause generated. The instance itself is excluded by the `isInstance` rule in check_audit_coverage.py; this is a constant underneath it.
